The registered interface

PALOMAR-2026-08-26-000005 v4 records four selected declarations, using Lean 4.33.0. The exact source is 39a6ba1940a1523e7491e32889f61afd235bb8df.

The interface is in Challenge.lean; its proofs are in Solution.lean. All names below are in namespace CollatzFirstPassage.

critical_polylogarithmic_descent_with_arbitrary_multipliers
Critical polylogarithmic descent with prescribed divergent target and height multipliers, common landing, and centered clocks.
fixed_polylogarithmic_common_landing_centered_clocks_exact_rate
The fixed-exponent common landing and centered clocks, including the exact upper exceptional-rate endpoint.
eventually_fixedJointPolylogHeightFailureCount_ge_log_order
A reciprocal-order lower bound for failure of the joint conclusion, forced by its height ceiling.
stretchedLogCommonLandingWithRelativeHeightQuantitative
A quantitative stretched-logarithmic specialization with a relative-height ceiling.

The registered snapshot is the reference for these declarations; a moving default branch is a different source identity. The paper's current Hexagon deposit links this registration, while the registry's provenance lists SSRN and the earlier v4.0.0 archive. The formal statements, not the paper title alone, determine the verified scope.

Palomar records Comparator and NanoDa replay and the standard permitted axioms propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice. See the record for the pinned dependencies and verification evidence.

Earlier v3.2.4 theorem map and its separate Lean 4.15 release.
